requirement:
修复前端调用订票和支付相关 API 的 bug。
用户在订票流程中选择座位和支付时接口返回异常。
需要检查订票服务的座位调用和支付安全验证逻辑。

details.name: ts-payment-service
details.rationale: The bug involves payment security validation, and ts-preserve-other-service likely calls ts-payment-service to process payments.

details.name: ts-seat-service
details.rationale: The bug involves seat selection during booking, and ts-preserve-other-service likely calls ts-seat-service for seat availability and assignment.

details.name: ts-inside-payment-service
details.rationale: ts-inside-payment-service handles internal payment processing and may be invoked by ts-preserve-other-service for payment-related operations.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Booking flow creates orders, and ts-preserve-other-service likely interacts with ts-order-service to create or update orders.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: ts-order-other-service handles other order types and may be involved in the booking flow alongside ts-preserve-other-service.

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: Booking involves travel details, and ts-preserve-other-service may call ts-travel-service for trip information.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: ts-travel2-service provides alternative travel routes and may be used by ts-preserve-other-service for booking options.

details.name: ts-route-service
details.rationale: Route information is needed for booking, and ts-preserve-other-service may depend on ts-route-service for route details.

details.name: ts-route-plan-service
details.rationale: Route planning may be part of the booking flow, and ts-preserve-other-service could call ts-route-plan-service.

details.name: ts-price-service
details.rationale: Price calculation is essential for payment, and ts-preserve-other-service may call ts-price-service to get ticket prices.

details.name: ts-auth-service
details.rationale: Payment security validation may involve authentication, and ts-preserve-other-service might call ts-auth-service for user verification.

details.name: ts-security-service
details.rationale: Security checks for payment could involve ts-security-service, which may be called by ts-preserve-other-service.

details.name: ts-user-service
details.rationale: User information is needed for booking and payment, and ts-preserve-other-service may call ts-user-service to fetch user details.

details.name: ts-contacts-service
details.rationale: Contact information may be used in booking, and ts-preserve-other-service could interact with ts-contacts-service.
